# Ronstation Server Rules Welcome to Ronstation, a curated MRP Starlight fork of SS14. This is a 16+ roleplay server.
Not all rules are intuitive or easy to understand. If you have any questions regarding rules, please contact admins using the AHelp button (F1), or ask in our Discord server. If you notice someone breaking rules, contact us.
You'll generally do fine as long as you maintain a friendly demeanor and try to remain fair to other players. Not having read the rules is not a justifiable reason to break them, but you are not expected to know every detail. Be aware that some of the most important core rules are zero tolerance, meaning that violations may result in indefinite bans without a warning. \n
## CORE RULES - These always apply, in gameplay and out of character.
- [textlink="0. Admins have a final say." link="RuleRSC0"] - [textlink="1. Avoid being a negative influence on others experience." link="RuleRSC1"] - [textlink="2. No hate speech or discriminatory language." link="RuleRSC2"] - [textlink="3. No sexual content, including erotic roleplay (ERP) and no shock content." link="RuleRSC3"] - [textlink="4. Players need to be and act the age of 16+." link="RuleRSC4"] - [textlink="5. Don't attempt to evade bans, and don't use alt accounts or share accounts." link="RuleRSC5"] - [textlink="6. Don't exploit the game, use cheats, or macros." link="RuleRSC6"] - [textlink="7. Don't misuse, abuse or ignore admin messages." link="RuleRSC7"] - [textlink="8. Only use English." link="RuleRSC8"] - [textlink="9. No EORG - Do not grief protected areas" link="RuleRSC9"] \n
## ROLEPLAY RULES - These apply during gameplay.
- [textlink="1. Don't act like an antagonist unless the game says you are one." link="RuleRSR1"] - [textlink="2. As a crew-aligned non-antagonist, follow reasonable escalation." link="RuleRSR2"] - [textlink="3. Don't interfere with players joining, leaving, or ending the round." link="RuleRSR3"] - [textlink="4. You are expected to roleplay without breaking immersion." link="RuleRSR4"] - [textlink="5. Don't use information gained outside of in-character means." link="RuleRSR5"] - [textlink="6. Do not metagame; Obey the Metashield." link="RuleRSR6"] - [textlink="7. Don't give unfair treatment based on who is playing a character." link="RuleRSR7"] - [textlink="8. Listen to your team leader and don't abandon your role." link="RuleRSR8"] \n
## ROLE SPECIFIC RULES - These apply only to the role.
- [textlink="1. Silicons must follow their laws." link="RuleRSS1"] - [textlink="2. Familiars must obey their master." link="RuleRSS2"] - [textlink="3. Security and Command must be competent, with positive impact." link="RuleRSS3"] - [textlink="4. Antagonists must follow antag-specific rules, with limited impact." link="RuleRSS4"] - [textlink="5. Free agents must follow FA-specific rules, with limited impact." link="RuleRSS5"]
